reviews.reviewText: Extremely fresh tomatoes! Firm and full of natural sweet flavour. Made tomato bhorta and fresh salad — taste was miles ahead of regular market tomatoes.

reply.replyText: Thank you so much Tanvir bhai! We source these freshly harvested from Sylhet every morning. Enjoy your fresh meals!

reviews.reviewText: No chemicals smell or artificial ripening. 100% natural, delivered in well-ventilated paper packaging. Very impressed with the packaging quality.
Good quality, nice vibrant red colour. A few were slightly soft due to transit heat, but overall still great quality.
Authentic Chandpur Padma Hilsa! Fresh silver shine, firm texture, and the aroma while cooking filled the whole house. Full of natural fish oil.

reply.replyText: Glad you loved our Padma Ilish! We take pride in delivering authenticated fish with frozen gel ice pack packaging.

reviews.reviewText: Exact 1kg weight as promised. Very fresh eyes and gills were red. Perfect for Shorshe Ilish!
As a doctor, I'm very cautious about honey adulteration. Did water test and flame test on this Sundarbans honey — passes with flying colours! Authentic floral aroma.
Raw and unprocessed honey. Has tiny pollen grains visible which proves it wasn't ultra-filtered or heated. Daily spoon with warm lemon water is heavenly.
Made Payesh with this Gobindobhog rice. The aromatic fragrance spread everywhere. Clean, uniform small grains with zero stones or husk.
Pungent, strong jhaal just like village ghani mustard oil. Real cold-pressed mustard oil is hard to find in Dhaka nowadays, PureBD Mart delivered true quality.
Granular (danadar) texture and golden color. Tastes like grandma's homemade desi ghee. Best accompaniment for hot rice.
